svg.title: Navet product card anatomy
svg.desc: The exact Main floor climate card from the maintained Navet demo Home screenshot, annotated with identity, live state, context, actions, and conditional exception guidance.
svg.metadata: Generated from assets/reference/marketing/screenshots/navet-ipad-landscape-home.jpg. UI is the implemented ClimateCard; no card geometry or icon has been redrawn.

g.text: The demo Home card is the reference. This specimen is the implemented component, not a redraw.
Exceptions appear only when something is genuinely wrong
This healthy demo state has no invented alert, badge, or warning treatment.
Identity → current state → real exception → common action → secondary detail
Source: maintained demo Home screenshot · component: ClimateCard · Storybook: Cards/Entity/Climate → Medium
